review_state: production rev 1 - M1, awaiting owner look review
purpose: Creature antler part (PROPOSED): a moose's palmate antler, a short beam opening into a broad cupped palm fringed with flat blunt points, and a brow tine (mirrored at bake for the left).

textures.name: T_PartAntlerPalmate_Albedo
textures.packing: greyscale albedo detail (baked AO darkens crevices), times each material's base colour

textures.name: T_PartAntlerPalmate_ORM
textures.packing: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

handles.meaning: the palm and its points 25% broader and longer

part_rules.handles_note: The keys are on AntlerPalmate (beam, palm and points); the pedicle (AntlerPalmatePedicle) stays put under the burr.

reduction.method: Blender collapse decimation within a surface tolerance; full-detail shading baked to the normal map

review_notes.gate1_shape: pass: a moose's palmate antler - a short beam from a furred pedicle and knobbly burr running out sideways into a broad flat palm, cupped forward and rising up and in, its upper edge and far end drawn out into a fringe of eight flat blunt points with low ribs leading into them, and a brow tine reaching forward off the beam (0.263 x 0.11 x 0.283 m); broad from the front and back, a thin plate edge-on from the side. H1_Span broadens the palm, H2_Tilt raises it, without tearing. In a scratch geometry preview the first draft was a balloon on a thin neck with thorn-like spikes, then showed a star of creases where the point lobes reached the palm's centre (the lobes now grow from the outer part only).
review_notes.gate2_materials: pass: two finishes - antler bone (tan with gutters and fine knobs, darker and pearled at the burr, pale cream points from the per-vertex Tip weight) over short brown fur on the pedicle. The first two bakes read as an even sandy cream with no pale points.
review_notes.gate3_neutral_light: pass: under the neutral white rig the palm's broad face shows its gutters and the ribs into the points without clipping; the burr's knobs read by grazing light.
review_notes.gate4_godot: pass: on the boar (a mirrored pair added at u 125, ring 90, scale 1000 in memory, after_boar_antler_palmate.jpg) the pair loads, seats on the head with the burr knob at each base without floating or deep clipping, mirrors correctly and is in scale, and reads as moose antlers - broad cupped palms with a fringe of points - at the world camera's distance and in the close and side views; the bone reads pale grey-cream under the editor room's blue light.

provenance: Authored procedurally in Blender by tools/blender/make_more_creature_parts.py, with helpers from tools/blender/make_creature_parts.py; no external or generated meshes. Textures baked in Blender from procedural shaders.
